title: IdentityTripleCorrectedPayload
description: Payload of the IdentityTripleCorrected event, published by masterdata-svc when a confirmed correction of an identity triple takes effect and consumed by submission-svc to reprocess the affected documents (INV-REQ-1006, INV-AC-7823; owner answers INV-Q-7876 option A and INV-Q-8012). The consumer dedupes on entityRef plus constitution plus changeRef. The payload carries no Doc UUIDs because masterdata-svc holds none; the consumer finds the affected documents itself. accessPointEscalation is always true: it flags the case for escalation to the Access Point. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The entity whose identity triple was corrected.

constitution.description: The constitution of the corrected identity triple.

effectiveFrom.description: The original date from which the correction is effective.

changeRef.description: Reference of the confirmed identity triple change.

accessPointEscalation.description: Flags the case for escalation to the Access Point (INV-AC-1056); the escalation itself takes place outside the System.
